q1: SELECT beer, MAX(price) - MIN(price) AS price_gap, AVG(price) AS avg_price FROM serves WHERE beer IN (SELECT s.beer FROM serves AS s, frequents AS f WHERE s.bar = f.bar AND f.drinker LIKE 'B%' GROUP BY s.beer HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.bar) >= 2) GROUP BY beer ORDER BY beer
q2: SELECT s1.beer, MAX(s1.price) - MIN(s1.price) AS price_gap, AVG(s1.price) AS avg_price FROM serves AS s1 WHERE s1.beer IN (SELECT s2.beer FROM serves AS s2 JOIN frequents AS f1 ON f1.bar = s2.bar JOIN drinker AS d1 ON d1.name = f1.drinker WHERE d1.name LIKE 'B%') GROUP BY s1.beer HAVING COUNT(s1.bar) >= 2
